newsitem.title: USA: Air & Water Tech now sees 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Air & Water Tech now sees 1996 loss.

text.p: Air & Water Technologies Corp has revised its 1996 earnings projections and now sees a slight net loss in the year ending October 31, the company's 10-Q filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission said.

The company had projected a slightly positive net income for the year. The 10Q made available in New York by the Branchburg, N.J., based company said the loss would be less than 1995's loss of $8 million.
It also reported a nine month loss of $4.7 million compared with a year earlier loss of $10.9 million.
Discussing the expected loss, the company said it is experiencing delays in awards of new contracts in each of its segmemnts. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
